## Component Props Digest

Compact: name, first line of description, then prop: type = default. Full detail in `src/app/data/component-api.json`.

### Alert
Alert - compact feedback surface with contextual severity.
  - children: ReactNode
  - size: "sm" | "md" = md
  - title: string
  - tone: 'success' | 'danger' | 'warning' | 'info' = info

### AlertDialog
AlertDialog root + parts. Controlled via `open`/`onOpenChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`.
  - children: React.ReactNode
  - defaultOpen: boolean
  - onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  - open: boolean

### AppShell
AppShell — the app frame for web apps: header, sidebar, main and an optional aside (hds#875).
  - aside: ReactNode
  - asideLabel: string = Details
  - children: ReactNode
  - className: string
  - collapsed: boolean
  - defaultCollapsed: boolean = false
  - header: ReactNode
  - onCollapsedChange: (collapsed: boolean) => void
  - persistKey: string
  - sidebar: ReactNode | ((state: AppShellSidebarState) => ReactNode)
  - sidebarLabel: string = Main

### AssetImg
AssetImg - responsive asset frame with fallback placeholder handling. Contexts: default, lightbox, and detail.
  - alt: string
  - className: string
  - context: 'default' | 'lightbox' | 'detail' = default
  - draggable: boolean = false
  - expandable: boolean = true
  - expandLabel: string
  - isDark: boolean = false
  - loading: "lazy" | "eager" = lazy
  - naturalHeight: number
  - naturalWidth: number
  - onClick: (e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void
  - onMouseDown: (e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void
  - onMouseLeave: (e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void
  - onMouseMove: (e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void
  - onMouseUp: (e: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>) => void
  - src: string
  - style: CSSProperties = {}
  - title: string

### AsyncState
One wrapper for the four states of async content: `loading` (skeleton rows plus a polite status line that turns into "Still trying…" after `slowAfterMs`), `err…
  - children: ReactNode
  - empty: ReactNode
  - error: string
  - errorTitle: string = Something went wrong
  - label: string = Content
  - loadingLabel: string = Loading
  - onRetry: () => void
  - rows: number = 3
  - slowAfterMs: number = 10000
  - slowNote: string = Still trying…
  - status: 'loading' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'ready'

### Avatar
Circular avatar. Renders the image when available, else initials from `alt` or a person icon, with an optional status dot.
  - alt: string
  - fallback: "initials" | "icon" = initials
  - initials: string
  - size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
  - src: string
  - status: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'
  - statusLabel: string

### AvatarGroup
Renders up to `max` overlapping avatars followed by a `+N` overflow chip.
  - children: ReactNode
  - max: number
  - size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null

### Badge
Compact metadata/status chip. Tone is the only styling input.
  - as: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements> = span
  - count: number
  - dot: boolean = false
  - label: string
  - max: number
  - size: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
  - tone: "success" | "danger" | "warning" | "info" | "neutral" | "inProgress" | null

### Blockquote
A quoted passage; pass `cite` for the source URL and `attribution` for a byline.
  - attribution: ReactNode
  - size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null

### Board
Status columns that sit side by side from tablet width and stack in order, first column on top, below it. Read-only: it has no drag handlers.
  - children: ReactNode

### BoardColumn
One status column: a heading with the title and a count, then its items. The column is a labelled region and the count is part of the heading's name.
  - children: ReactNode
  - count: number
  - title: ReactNode

### Box
Box — polymorphic layout primitive with a token-first `sx` engine. `sx` is a deliberate SUBSET of MUI's sx — not all of CSS-in-JS is a feature: - Spacing short…
  - as: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements> = div
  - children: ReactNode
  - sx: SxObject

### Breadcrumb
Breadcrumb trail. Links route through the HDS router seam (plain anchors with no router, client-side nav when a router adapter is provided). The final item is …
  - items: BreadcrumbItem[]
  - label: string = Breadcrumb

### Button
Triggers an action when activated.
  - asChild: boolean = false
  - defaultPressed: boolean
  - disabled: boolean
  - flush: boolean = false
  - hoverEffect: "none" | "wipe" = wipe
  - iconLeft: ReactNode
  - iconOnly: boolean = false
  - iconRight: ReactNode
  - label: string
  - loading: boolean = false
  - onPressedChange: (pressed: boolean) => void
  - pressed: boolean
  - shadow: "none" | "hard" = hard
  - size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | null
  - tone: "success" | "danger" | "warning" | "info" | "neutral" | "quiet" | null
  - variant: "link" | "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary" | null

### Callout
Tone-driven tinted callout for notes, quotes, hypotheses — the same feedback fill language as Alert, without Alert's icon or status role.
  - italic: boolean = false
  - tone: 'accent' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' = info

### Card

  - value: string

### Tooltip
Tooltip root. Bakes in the Radix Provider so a single `<Tooltip>` is self-contained — no app-level provider required. Controlled via `open`/`onOpenChange`, or …
  - children: React.ReactNode
  - defaultOpen: boolean
  - delayDuration: number
  - disableHoverableContent: boolean
  - onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  - open: boolean

### VisuallyHidden
Renders its children off-screen (Tailwind `sr-only`) so they are announced by screen readers without occupying visual space — e.g. a text label for an icon-onl…
  - as: ElementType<any, keyof IntrinsicElements> = span
